about_page.subtitle: Estabelecendo métricas transparentes de indexação para a ciência africana.
about_page.mission_text1: As revistas científicas publicadas em África enfrentam frequentemente barreiras estruturais para inclusão em bases globais. O AfriJournal Indexing foi fundado para preencher esta lacuna.
about_page.mission_text2: A nossa plataforma avalia diretrizes de qualidade com rigor, verificando normas de ISSN, conselhos editoriais e contribuições regionais.
about_page.partner_text: O AfriJournal Indexing alinha-se com os princípios do COPE e de acesso aberto para fornecer uma infraestrutura independente que salvaguarda a integridade da investigação africana e a sua visibilidade global.
about_page.pillar_open_text: Sem custos para indexar ou consultar a produção científica africana.
about_page.pillar_metrics_text: Modelos transparentes que refletem a dinâmica real de citações em África.
about_page.pillar_capacity_text: Relatórios de auditoria automatizados que ajudam as equipas a aprimorar fluxos de trabalho.

methodology_page.criteria_3: Regularidade de Publicação: Pelo menos dois números anuais sem anos em falta.
methodology_page.criteria_4: Segurança do Domínio: Encriptação HTTPS e página web ativa e funcional.

items.q: O que é o AfriJournal Indexing?
items.a: O AfriJournal Indexing (AJCI) é uma plataforma de indexação académica em acesso aberto criada para revistas de investigação africanas.
Sim. A pesquisa, exploração de rankings e criação de perfil de investigador são 100% gratuitos.

terms_page.title: Termos & Condições
terms_page.subtitle: Leia atentamente estes termos antes de utilizar a plataforma.
terms_page.sec1_p1: Ao utilizar o AfriJournal Indexing, confirma que leu, compreendeu e aceita estes Termos & Condições.
terms_page.sec1_p2: Se utilizar a plataforma em nome de uma instituição, declara ter autoridade para vincular essa entidade.
terms_page.sec2_p1: O AfriJournal Indexing é um motor aberto de indexação académica que cataloga e avalia revistas africanas. A plataforma disponibiliza:
terms_page.sec2_li1: Submissão de revistas e avaliação automatizada de conformidade
terms_page.sec2_li2: Pontuação de Índice de Citação (AJCI padrão e regional)
terms_page.sec2_li3: Perfis de investigadores com análise de índice h
terms_page.sec3_p1: Deve ter pelo menos 18 anos para criar uma conta e fornecer informações fidedignas.
terms_page.sec4_p1: Ao submeter uma revista, garante ser representante autorizado e que todos os dados são genuínos.
terms_page.sec5_p1: Todo o conteúdo e algoritmos da plataforma são propriedade intelectual do AfriJournal Indexing.
terms_page.sec6_p1: Estes Termos são regidos pelas normas académicas e legislações aplicáveis.
terms_page.sec3_li1: Keep account passwords confidential and secure.
terms_page.sec3_li2: Notify support immediately if any unauthorized access is suspected.
terms_page.sec3_li3: Do not share publisher administrative credentials across multiple unverified parties.
terms_page.sec3_li4: Maintain an up-to-date academic email address for official compliance notifications.
terms_page.sec3_p2: AfriJournal Indexing reserves the right to suspend accounts with fraudulent credentials.
terms_page.sec4_li1: Submissions must include verified Print ISSN or Online eISSN registrations.
terms_page.sec4_li2: Editorial boards must include qualified scholars with verifiable institutional affiliations.
terms_page.sec4_li3: Clear, public double-blind or peer-review policies must be published on the journal domain.
terms_page.sec4_li4: Journals must maintain regular publication schedules with consecutive issue archives.
terms_page.sec4_li5: Journals must respect publication ethics aligned with COPE and DOAJ principles.
terms_page.sec4_p2: Failure to satisfy these warranties may result in immediate evaluation failure or de-indexing.
terms_page.sec5_li1: Automated technical screening verifies HTTPS security and ISSN checksums in real time.
terms_page.sec5_li2: Temporary technical connectivity issues can be re-tested immediately with zero waiting penalty.
terms_page.sec5_li3: Editorial integrity failures trigger a 180-day cooling-off window for the affected ISSN.
terms_page.sec5_li4: Editorial teams receive diagnostic audit logs detailing specific remediation criteria.
terms_page.sec6_li1: Periodic re-crawls verify continuous domain security and issue publication regularity.
terms_page.sec6_li2: Evidence of paper mill infiltration or unrefereed publication sprees causes instant revocation.
terms_page.sec6_li3: Coercive self-citation or citation stacking cartels are detected via bibliometric algorithms.
terms_page.sec6_li4: De-indexed journals are notified with an itemized statement of compliance revocation.
terms_page.sec6_p2: Publishers may appeal de-indexing decisions after implementing corrective measures.
terms_page.sec7_p1: Publishers and authors retain all original copyrights to their scientific articles and editorial content. By submitting to AfriJournal Indexing, publishers grant the platform a non-exclusive license to index, display, compute bibliometrics for, and distribute bibliographic metadata under open academic standards.
terms_page.sec7_p2: All metric algorithms, badges, and software interfaces are the proprietary property of AfriJournal Indexing.
terms_page.sec8_title: Disclaimer of Warranties & Limitation of Liability
terms_page.sec8_p1: The Platform and its calculated metrics are provided on an 'as is' and 'as available' basis. AfriJournal Indexing makes no guarantees that platform operations will be uninterrupted or error-free.
terms_page.sec8_p2: To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, AfriJournal Indexing and its advisory committee shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from reliance on platform data or indexing decisions.

privacy_page.title: Política de Privacidade
privacy_page.subtitle: A sua privacidade é fundamental para nós.
privacy_page.sec1_p1: O AfriJournal Indexing é uma infraestrutura académica continental independente com sede em Nairobi, Quénia.
privacy_page.sec2_p1: Recolhemos dados de conta (nome, e-mail, palavra-passe encriptada, ORCID) e dados bibliográficos.
privacy_page.sec3_p1: Utilizamos os dados para gerir acessos, avaliar revistas e calcular métricas bibliométricas.
privacy_page.sec4_p1: Implementamos medidas padrão da indústria com encriptação avançada para proteger os seus dados.
privacy_page.sec2_li1_1: Full name, academic email address, and securely hashed passwords (bcrypt)
privacy_page.sec2_li1_2: Institutional affiliation and primary academic discipline
privacy_page.sec2_li1_5: Contact details provided during editorial inquiries
privacy_page.sec2_li2_1: Journal metadata (title, ISSN/eISSN, publisher, website URL, frequency)
privacy_page.sec2_li2_2: Published article titles, DOIs, abstracts, and author bylines harvested via public OAI-PMH or Crossref feeds
privacy_page.sec2_li2_3: Authorship claims submitted by registered researchers
privacy_page.sec2_li3_1: Server logs (IP address, browser user-agent, request timestamps) for security monitoring
privacy_page.sec2_li3_2: Automated crawler audit logs verifying journal website responsiveness and SSL encryption
privacy_page.sec2_li3_3: Session cookies required strictly for platform authentication
privacy_page.sec3_li1: Verifying journal eligibility and calculating AJCI citation impact indicators
privacy_page.sec3_li2: Generating researcher profile pages, verified authorship records, and h-index metrics
privacy_page.sec3_li3: Aggregating university-level research outputs for the Institutional Leaderboard
privacy_page.sec3_li4: Communicating evaluation results, crawler audit logs, and account notices
privacy_page.sec3_li5: Detecting and preventing abusive automated traffic or fraudulent claims
privacy_page.sec3_li6: Generating anonymized continental research output analytics
privacy_page.sec3_li7: Maintaining platform security, SSL verification, and system reliability
privacy_page.sec4_li1: Contractual necessity for providing requested indexing and user account services
privacy_page.sec4_li2: Legitimate academic interest in maintaining transparent, publicly verifiable scientific bibliometrics
privacy_page.sec4_li3: Explicit user consent provided upon registration or editorial inquiry
privacy_page.sec5_p1: In accordance with scholarly communication standards, academic metadata—including journal titles, published article metadata, author names, institutional affiliations, and linked public ORCID IDs—are part of the permanent public scholarly record.
privacy_page.sec5_li1: Public scholarly metadata is discoverable via the open catalog and researcher consoles.
privacy_page.sec5_li2: Personal account credentials and private contact emails are never displayed publicly.
privacy_page.sec5_li3: Researchers may claim or unclaim publications from their profile at any time.
privacy_page.sec5_p2: We do not sell, rent, or lease academic or personal data to third parties under any circumstances.
privacy_page.sec6_p1: AfriJournal Indexing does not host commercial third-party advertisements, behavioral tracking pixels, or data broker integrations. Your browsing activity on this platform is never monetized or shared with marketing networks.
privacy_page.sec7_p1: We implement robust security safeguards including end-to-end HTTPS encryption, salted bcrypt password hashing, and role-based database access controls. Under applicable data protection regulations, you hold the right to:
privacy_page.sec7_li1: Access: Request a copy of the personal data held about your account.
privacy_page.sec7_li2: Rectification: Correct any inaccurate personal or affiliation details in your profile.
privacy_page.sec7_li3: Erasure: Request the deletion of your user account and personal credentials.
privacy_page.sec7_li4: Restriction: Object to or restrict specific processing of your personal information.
privacy_page.sec7_li5: Data Portability: Request an export of your claimed publication data in standard formats.
privacy_page.sec7_p2: To exercise any of these rights, contact our data protection team via our Contact page or at privacy@afrijournalindexing.org.
